parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description:
The filter conditions.

You can specify at most five filter conditions in each call.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: **1** to **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the CEN instance belongs.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description:
The tags.

You can specify at most 20 tags in each call.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cbn describe-cens --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --resource-group-id rg-acfm3unpnuw0000 --filter '[{"Value":["cen-44m0p68spvlrqq0000"],"Key":"CenId"}]' --tag Value=tagtest Key=tagtest --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cbn DescribeCens --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key tagtest --PageSize 10 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm3unpnuw0000' --PageNumber 1 --Filter.1.Value.1 'cen-44m0p68spvlrqq0000' --Tag.1.Value tagtest --Filter.1.Key CenId
